visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young woman in her 20s, wearing a tan hiking vest over a black long-sleeved shirt, black trousers, and a wide-brimmed khaki sun hat. She is walking away from the camera up a series of stone steps bordered by a green bamboo-style fence in a lush, green forest setting with natural, filtered daylight. A red circle highlights a distant figure further up the path. (2) The woman turns to face the camera, her expression one of pleasant surprise. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a black flat surface decorated with a pink Chinese character "龍" and a stylized eye illustration. (3) A man with short grey hair, wearing a black t-shirt with "龍" on the back and blue shorts, is shown from behind. He is using a large, traditional broom made of twigs and a bamboo pole to sweep the stone trail. The surrounding forest is dense with green trees and foliage. (4) The young woman approaches the man. The camera captures her black backpack with a green cover and various accessories. They engage in conversation. Close-up shots focus on the man's hands on the broom handle and his worn hiking boots on the stone steps. (5) A montage of artistic signs and painted stones appears. One green sign has a tree made of pink petals held by two purple hands. A white stone has the character "輕" and a blue wing graphic. A purple surface has "爬山生活" in yellow paint. An orange and green sign reads "夢想家 巢穴". (6) The woman speaks directly to the camera, framed in a medium shot. She has two pigtails and a cheerful expression. The background consists of out-of-focus green trees. She points behind her as she recounts the story.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a heartwarming encounter during a hike on Feifeng Mountain in Hsinchu. The creator introduces a long-term foreign resident named Peter, who voluntarily cleans the mountain trails and creates localized art to improve the environment. The purpose is to share this inspiring story of community service and cross-cultural appreciation.
